title: Sale sources
subtitle: Receive sales from any platform through a dedicated URL and turn the received JSON into CRM sales.

common.error: The action could not be completed.

create.title: New sale source
create.hmac: Generate an HMAC secret to sign requests
create.hmacHint: The secret is shown only once after creating. Without a secret, anyone with the URL can send sales.

delete.title: Delete sale source
delete.body: The source "{name}" and its event log will be deleted and the URL stops working. This cannot be undone.

url.title: Receiving URL
url.hint: Set this URL in the sales platform (POST with a JSON body).

rotate.title: Rotate the URL token?
rotate.body: A new URL will be generated and the current one stops working immediately. Update the sales platform with the new URL.
rotate.withSecret: Also generate a new HMAC secret

secret.title: HMAC secret
secret.hint: With a secret, each request needs the {header} header with the HMAC-SHA256 of the body in hex.
secret.once: Copy it now: the secret will not be shown again.
secret.replaceBody: The current secret stops working immediately. Requests signed with it will be rejected.
secret.removeBody: Requests will no longer be signed: anyone with the URL can send sales.

mapping.title: Mapping
mapping.hint: For each sale field, enter the JSONPath in the received body (e.g. $.data.buyer.phone, $.items[0].id). Fields with * are required.
mapping.productHint: To link the sale to a product, the platform must send the product internal ID in the field mapped to product_id.
mapping.productPick: Pick a product to see its internal ID

statusMap.title: Status map
statusMap.hint: Translate the platform statuses. Common values (paid, approved, refunded, chargeback…) are already recognized.

sample.title: Test with a sample
sample.hint: Paste a JSON sent by the platform to see the resulting sale with the current mapping (nothing is saved).
sample.pickInto: Click a sample value to fill the field:
sample.failed: The mapping does not produce a valid sale

events.title: Event log
events.hint: Requests received by this source and their processing result.

errors.name: The name must have 2 to 120 characters
